description: Source code for the MainWindow class implementing a Windows GUI window with toolbar, URL bar, and browser integration for a WebKit-based browser project.

classes.name: MainWindow
classes.description: Represents the main application window with toolbar, URL bar, and embedded browser.

methods.name: loadURL
methods.description: Loads the specified URL into the embedded browser, converting file paths to URLs if necessary.

methods.name: activeURLChanged
methods.description: Updates the URL bar text when the active URL changes.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures static flags for remote control and accelerated compositing.

methods.name: isInstance
methods.description: Checks if a given HWND is an instance of MainWindow.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the main window, creates toolbar and browser components.

methods.name: resizeSubViews
methods.description: Resizes child views within the main window based on current window size.

methods.name: resizeToolbar
methods.description: Adjusts the size of the toolbar and URL bar.

methods.name: rescaleToolbar
methods.description: Rescales toolbar elements based on device scale factor.

methods.name: toggleMenuItem
methods.description: Toggles the checked state of a menu item.
